## Page 18

Next Generation Aircraft in Fleet
THAI modernized its fleet with the launch of the Airbus A321neo, featuring upgraded cabin 
products and enhanced fuel efficiency for short and medium -haul routes. The new configuration 
includes four single Throne Seats and twelve Double Seats in Royal Silk Class, offering180 -degree 
flat-beds and high -speed inflight internet reaching up to 300 Mbps. This initiative supports the 
airline’s sustainability goals by improving fuel efficiency, reducing carbon emissions, and noise 
levels while elevating the passenger experience. Initial operations are set for key regional hubs, 
including Singapore, Delhi, and Phuket, beginning in early 2026.
17Source: Company InformationTHAI Unveils Airbus A321neo, Showcasing New Cabin and Products 
to Elevate the Travel ExperienceCAPA Airline Leader Summit
THAI CEO, Mr. Chai Eamsiri , participated in the CAPA Airline Leader Summit 2025 in 
Singapore, highlighting the airline’s successful two -year turnaround driven by strategic 
restructuring and consistent financial growth. The presentation emphasized THAI’s evolution 
into a 'Network Airline,' leveraging Bangkok as a global hub to diversify revenue and mitigate 
market risks. This strategic direction focuses on fleet modernization and elevating premium 
products to meet the evolving demands of modern travelers and deliver a superior end -to-end 
journey.CEO Strategic Vision and Global Network Leadership

## Page 19

Opportunities in a Reset Economy
THAI CEO, Mr. Chai Eamsiri , shared strategic insights at the "Opportunities in a Reset 
Economy" forum by PMAT. The discussion highlighted THAI’s resilience through core values: 
Agility, Integrity, and Mastery (AIM), which empowered the organization to navigate major crises. 
This leadership approach emphasizes adaptability to modern corporate contexts and technological 
shifts. The vision remains focused on the "Network Airline" strategy to expand market share, 
stimulate job creation, and drive sustainable economic growth for Thailand.
18Source: Company InformationTHAI Shares Modern Leadership Insights for Sustainable GrowthSkyconomy
THAI CEO, Mr. Chai Eamsiri , participated in the “ Skyconomy ” seminar to align the “Network 
Airline” strategy with national aviation hub goals. The discussion highlighted leveraging 
Suvarnabhumi Airport as a global gateway to enhance Thailand’s regional connectivity. This 
commitment reinforces THAI’s role as the Home Base Carrier through strategic investments in 
infrastructure. Key projects include the development of a Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul 
(MRO) center at U -Tapao . The vision also focuses on expanding Cargo business units to 
solidify Thailand’s position as a regional air logistics hub.THAI Joins Skyconomy Forum to Drive Thailand 
as a Regional Aviation Hub

outstanding leadership in driving positive change and improving quality of life and the environment. The award reflects wides pread confidence

THAI CEO, Mr. Chai Eamsiri , was honored for his visionary leadership in transforming the airline 
from significant losses to strong profitability. By successfully implementing a strategic 
rehabilitation plan and restructuring, he led THAI to exit its crisis and return to the Stock 
Exchange of Thailand. This milestone restores stakeholder confidence and secures the airline’s 
future as a key driver of Thailand’s regional aviation hub.
